selected_need: Harden QIF v0.2 runtime model while preserving v0.2 executability
intended_user_or_segment: QIF framework maintainers, organizational quality reviewers, auditors, and AI review agents
context_summary: Existing v0.2 runtime already has discovery, culture, target, review-run packages and local validation; hardening must refine conceptual boundaries and traceability.
hypothesis: Separating reusable selection logic from target-specific decisions and adding extraction/governance entities will make QIF review packages more replayable and auditable.
rejected_alternatives: Do not make Organizational Quality Culture a mandatory prerequisite for Quality Intent derivation.
explicit_risks: Over-hardening could create checklist-only bureaucracy; verifier must remain structural and not semantic.
delivery_validation_requirements: Run npm test and AOF review artifacts after updating docs, schemas, examples, verifier, changelog, and runtime log.
need: Refine QIF v0.2 runtime ambiguity points without expanding scope.
intent: Produce an auditable model where extraction, applicability, verdict, and governance reasoning can be replayed.
context: Domain-general runtime; no UI; no external integration; no quality-as-activity-count; no expert-opinion-as-truth.
